2026 ACC/AHA (PREVENT-ASCVD), adults 30-79 w LDL 70-189 w/o DM:
10-yr risk <3% (low): moderate-intensity if LDL 160-189 or 30-yr risk ≥10%
3-<5% (borderline): moderate-intensity (± CAC to decide whether to start lipid-lowering tx)
40-75yo + DM: moderate-intensity; DM + multiple ASCVD RFs -> high-intensity
>75yo + DM + life expectancy ≥2.5y: moderate-intensity after risk/benefit discussion
20-39yo + long-duration DM, albuminuria, eGFR <60, retinopathy, neuropathy, or ABI <0.9: moderate-intensity
